hero.heading: Hi, I'm Khang
hero.bio: I'm a software engineer with nearly 3 years of experience building online marketplace platforms across diverse business models — with a strong focus on scalability, reliability, and long-term maintainability in fast-paced product teams. Based in Ho Chi Minh City.

highlights.title: For Product Teams
highlights.desc: React/Redux frontends and Node.js/Express backends for marketplace platforms — payments, bookings, and integrations built for scale.

highlights.title: For AI-Driven Products
highlights.desc: Semantic search, embeddings and LLM integrations — applying OpenAI's API to real product features, from search to multilingual content.

experience.heading: Experience
experience.subheading: A track record of delivering reliable software in fast-paced product teams.

items.desc: Contributed to the development and delivery of 10+ marketplace platforms built on Sharetribe, supporting different business models. Built responsive React/Redux frontends and Node.js/Express backend APIs integrating payments, databases and AWS services, while supporting business analysts and clients through requirements and issue resolution.

projects.heading: Projects
projects.subheading: A selection of platforms and features I've designed and shipped.

items.title: Localmingo
items.desc: A marketplace connecting travelers with local guides and unique travel experiences. Built off-session payments with Stripe SetupIntent and automated payout retries, scheduled multi-currency exchange-rate syncing, and AI-assisted multilingual support for listings and reviews.

items.title: GearShare
items.desc: An AI-powered B2B marketplace for renting professional live-event equipment. Built a natural-language semantic search pipeline with OpenAI embeddings, event-driven async processing via RabbitMQ and AWS SQS, and a bidirectional inventory sync system with automated EC2 provisioning.

items.title: AI-Powered Automated Grading
items.desc: An AI-powered system that automatically evaluates student submissions against expected solutions, generating scores and actionable feedback to help learners identify and correct mistakes.

items.title: Internal Knowledge Chatbot
items.desc: A retrieval-augmented (RAG) AI assistant that answers employee questions by grounding responses in internal company documents and policies.

items.title: Real vs. Fake Face Detection
items.desc: A computer vision research project using a fine-tuned ResNet-50 to classify real versus Stable Diffusion-generated face images, packaged as an interactive Streamlit app.

items.title: Document Scanner
items.desc: A lightweight OpenCV pipeline that turns raw photos into clean, high-contrast scanned documents — detecting edges, correcting perspective, and enhancing contrast automatically.
